sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The prior repair remains unmet: the COMPLETE dependency contract still assigns DIRECT_STATIC although its comparisonModel requires calculating iceLoadCycleCount × propellerBladeCount. The candidate checks only conditional presence, operand datatypes, and result representation; it never verifies effectiveIceLoadCycleCount against that product. Correct the dependency contract upstream to DIRECT_CALCULATION and regenerate.
